charts.title: EPIC 201170410 b: orbits around EPIC 201170410
charts.description: The orbits of EPIC 201170410's planets in this map from above, to scale, with EPIC 201170410 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.
